snippet.title: Northguard Battlegrounds - World Premiere Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
In the aftermath of Ragnarok, the ancient realm of Northgard lies in ruins. Northgard: Fimbul is an original spin-off game to the beloved RTS-classic combining asynchronous PvP auto-battles with tactical city building.

Claim leadership of your clan and bring the Gods to your side, or face their treacherous wrath on the battlegrounds.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
